hooks.text: 割草、建塔与守城全程同时进行，不暂停选建筑
hooks.excerpt: Fight hordes of the Khmar, level up your hero, collect weapons and artifacts and build structures and towers right in the middle of combat. There are no calm pauses for decisions - combat, building and survival all happen at the same time.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 2至4人分工守线、救队友或出城抢战利品
hooks.excerpt: Revive fallen allies, split roles and decide who holds the line while another player pushes out for loot.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 离信标越远风险越高，稀有资源回报也越大
hooks.excerpt: Venture beyond the base to search for rare resources, chests, altars, trials and enemy lairs. The farther you go from the Beacon, the greater the risk - and the more valuable the reward.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
